end.summary:
Identified ants, earthworms, and beetles as soil animals.
Practised the instruction “look closely” and suggested counting soil animals.
Pihu reported seeing one earthworm and two beetles.
The idea that earthworms harm soil was not corrected during the lesson.
Lesson ended when Pihu said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Asha practised observing soil animals and using “look closely” to count them. Pihu shared observations of an ant, an earthworm, and beetles. They also said earthworms harm soil; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, look at a small patch of soil together and count what is seen, without removing the animals.
